name: Pradheepa Ramasundaram
title: Senior Systems Engineer
tagline: MBSE | Requirements Engineering | System Architecture | ISO 26262

achievements: Designed AUTOSAR-compliant embedded software for ABS, ESP, ADAS, and hydrogen fuel cell applications.
Translated stakeholder and system requirements into production software through model-based development aligned with ISO 26262, ASPICE, and MISRA.
Built ECU state management, vehicle mode management, variant handling, and AUTOSAR communication services supporting vehicle-level functionality.
Developed control algorithms with MATLAB, Simulink, Stateflow, and TargetLink for safety-critical automotive programs.
Executed MIL and SIL verification using Simscape, Polyspace, and TPT to improve software quality and control system performance.
Mentored engineers on AUTOSAR architecture, braking systems, vehicle dynamics, and model-based engineering practices.
Own stakeholder and system requirements, functional and non-functional analysis, decomposition, allocation, and bidirectional traceability across the V-model.
Define logical and physical architectures with SysML across BDD, IBD, Use Case, Activity, Sequence, State Machine, Requirement, Parametric, and Boundary views.
Lead steer-by-wire architecture decisions, interface definition, change impact analysis, performance studies, trade-off analysis, FMEA/DFMEA, FTA, and ISO 26262 reviews.

certifications: University at Buffalo - Model-Based Systems Engineering
MathWorks - Systems Engineering; MATLAB, Simulink, Stateflow, Simscape & System Composer
education: B.Tech., Electronics & Instrumentation Engineering - Amrita School of Engineering
PG Certification in Automotive Systems - IIT Madras
